name: mcp-yandex-wordstat
description: Read Yandex search-demand statistics from Claude: how often a phrase is searched, when, and in which regions.

token.title: Yandex Cloud API key
token.description: API key with access to the Yandex Cloud Search API. Stored in your operating system's credential store, never in settings.json.

folder_id.title: Yandex Cloud folder id
folder_id.description: Folder the API key belongs to. Required: a key pointed at the wrong folder returns 401 or 403.

telemetry.title: Anonymous telemetry
telemetry.description: Set to 0 to disable the anonymous usage telemetry the server sends by default. Leave as 1 to keep it on.
